name: baoyu-diagram
tagline_zh: 一句话，从架构图到思维导图，自动生成专业暗色SVG。告别白底刺眼，让图表在深色模式下依然清晰惊艳。
tagline_en: One sentence to any diagram—architecture, flow, mind map—as sleek dark SVG. No more blinding white; clarity in.
desc_en: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org
why_zh: 不止是模板，而是理解你的意图，自动选型布局，暗色美学贯穿始终，细节到连线配色。
why_en: It doesn't just template—it understands intent, auto-selects layout, and applies dark aesthetics to every line and color.
